notes: «قال حدثت عن أبي صالح»: the passive «حدثت» names no transmitter, so it is an unnamed gap at that point (rule 8), not filled.
The second isnad («حدثنا بذلك عبيد بن أسباط …») carries the same saying after the matn, so it is a second group. «وكأن هذا أصح …» is the compiler's remark and is left out.
